title: Finance Assistant
description:
About the Role

An established and growing professional services business based in Bristol is looking to welcome a Finance Assistant to its expanding Finance team.

Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, you'll play an important role in ensuring the smooth, accurate and timely processing of financial transactions across both the sales and purchase ledgers.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous experience in an accounts or finance environment who is looking to develop their skills within a supportive and ambitious organisation.

You'll work with industry-standard accounting software, including Xero, and liaise with colleagues, suppliers and customers to help maintain efficient day-to-day financial operations.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and maintain the sales and purchase ledgers
- Raise customer invoices accurately and within agreed timescales
- Process supplier payments and staff expenses
- Reconcile bank transactions and assist with cash flow management
- Process invoices, remittances, direct debits and standing orders
- Monitor accounts payable and receivable
- Investigate and resolve financial discrepancies
- Assist with VAT returns
- Support the wider Finance team with general administrative duties
- Assist with month-end and year-end financial processes
- Contribute to ad-hoc finance projects and other duties as required by the Finance Manager and Directors

About You

We're looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Finance Assistant who takes pride in producing accurate work and can manage competing priorities in a busy environment.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience working within an accounts or finance department
- Experience using Xero or similar online accounting software
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Good organisational and time-management skills
- A self-motivated and proactive approach
- The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment
- A willingness to learn and develop within the role

What's on Offer?
- Enhanced pension contributions
- Six-monthly performance bonuses
- Private medical insurance
- Health and wellbeing programme
- Regular team social events
- Employee recognition and reward schemes
- Free on-site parking
- Casual dress code
- Professional development and training opportunities

Why Join?

You'll be joining a supportive and collaborative team where your contribution is valued. This is an opportunity to become an important part of a growing Finance function, with the scope to develop your skills and take on additional responsibilities over time.

The organisation is committed to creating an inclusive working environment and is an equal opportunities employer. Applications are welcomed from candidates of all backgrounds.

How to Apply

If you have previous experience in an accounts or finance role and are looking for your next opportunity in Bristol, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Interim Accounts Payable
company: Hays Accounts and Finance - Agency - Temporary
description:
About the Company

This organisation is a well-established public sector body responsible for managing and maintaining significant environmental and land-based assets across England. With a strong focus on sustainability, conservation, and community engagement, they play a key role in supporting both environmental objectives and public access initiatives.They offer a collaborative and purpose-driven working environment, where employees are encouraged to contribute to meaningful work while developing their professional skills within a supportive team.

About the Role

Due to ongoing demand within the finance function, our client is looking to recruit an Accounts Payable Assistant to join their established transactional finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to build on their existing experience within a structured and high-performing environment.You will be responsible for supporting the end-to-end accounts payable process, ensuring that all supplier transactions are handled accurately, efficiently, and in line with internal procedures.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Monitoring and prioritising the finance inbox, ensuring queries and invoices are dealt with promptly.
- Processing a high volume of supplier invoices, including accurate coding, VAT treatment, and matching to purchase orders.
- Liaising with budget holders to obtain timely invoice approvals.
- Processing authorised invoices for payment within agreed timeframes.
- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating any discrepancies.
- Setting up new supplier accounts in line with company policies and procedures.
- Responding to supplier queries in a professional and efficient manner.
- Liaising with internal teams and external stakeholders to maintain a high standard of service delivery.
- Providing ad hoc administrative and financial support to the wider finance team as required.

This role will suit someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment with a varied workload.

What You Will Need to Succeed

To be successful in this role, you will:
- Have previous experience in an Accounts Payable or transactional finance position.
- Possess strong attention to detail and accuracy when processing financial data.
- Have a good understanding of invoice processing, reconciliations, and VAT principles.
- Be highly organised, with the ability to prioritise workload effectively.
- Demonstrate strong communication skills and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders.
- Have a proactive and professional approach to resolving queries.
- Be comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
- Experience with finance systems and Microsoft Excel would be advantageous.

Details

Hourly Rate: 16.18/hour premium

Hybrid Working: Initially in 5 days a week to settle in, then hybrid working with 2 days in office

Length of Assignment: December 2026

Location: BS16 1 EJ

title: Part time Finance Assistant - 22. 5 hours per week
description:
Are you an experienced Finance Assistant searching for a new opportunity? We are looking for a Part Time Finance Assistant to join their team on a permanent basis. This role offers a great chance to be involved in essential financial processes, supporting the wider business with purchase ledger tasks, reconciliation, and basic account management. You'll be working closely with the finance team, ensuring smooth and accurate handling of transactions, all while maintaining a welcoming and professional approach. The position is office-based in Bath, perfect for someone looking to balance work and personal commitments, with a flexible, part-time schedule.

DAY TO DAY:
- Accounts payable, processing supplier invoices, using ApprovalMax, ensuring all invoices are allocated correctly, preparing invoices for approval
- Maintain the Accounts payable ledger and payment runs
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolving discrepancies, supplier onboarding and data capture
- Accounts receivable to include checking of rents, service charges, credit control, chasing payments, providing reports to Financial Controller
- Maintaining the ledger, allocating receipts, updating tenant accounts,
- Daily bank reconciliations, posting receipts and journals as needed, credit card reconciliations, tenant deposits,
- Providing reports to the team for service charge budgets using Xero, liaising with wider team re all finance queries,
- Assisting in the preparation of month-end, assisting with preparation of year-end
- Maintain an organised digital filing system, support FC with any other duties, support wider team when required

WE WOULD LOVE TO SEE:
- Previous experience as a Finance or Accounts Assistant, ideally in property or similar sector
- Knowledge of purchase ledger processes and financial reconciliations
- Confidence using accounting software, with experience in Xero being highly desirable
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills and a proactive attitude
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

AND FOR YOU:
- Benefits include competitive salary
- Flexible working hours - 5 shorter days or 3 full days
- Central Bath, modern office environment in established team
